text:
sam: Heads-up — CI on main is red after the poetry lock regen from yesterday. Failing in the linux wheel step and docker image build. :frowning:

maya: ugh, saw that. Which job is bombing? logs? :eyes:

sam: job `build-images:linux` fails on pip install step with a checksum mismatch, then wheel build error. copied snippet below:
```
ERROR: Could not build wheels for cryptography which use PEP 517 and cannot be installed directly
WARNING: pip is being invoked by an old setuptools which may not be compatible
````

ci-bot: Re-run triggered by @maya — build 3821 queued.

lee: could be the transitive upgrade in lockfile — last commit bumped `cffi` via constraints resolver. Any chance the regen pulled a new binary wheel tag?

jordan: I suspect the lock regen pulled a platform-incompatible wheel or changed the manylinux tag. Can someone try a quick local reproduce in a slim docker? `docker build -f ci/Dockerfile .`

sam: repro'd locally inside `python:3.10-slim` — same error during `pip wheel cryptography` step. Quick inspect of poetry.lock shows cryptography 40.0.0 -> depends on rust build change.

maya: ah, rust toolchain missing in the image then. But our previous wheels hid that. Did the lock regen switch from wheel to sdist for cryptography?

lee: looks like the resolver picked a source distribution because prebuilt wheel tag didn't match our manylinux baseline. That explains the build step and rust requirement.

sam: quick options: 1) revert lockfile commit to restore previous working set, 2) pin cryptography to previous wheel-compatible version in pyproject/constraints, or 3) add rust + cargo to the CI image and accept longer builds. Thoughts? :thinking:

jordan: short-term revert is safest to get CI green. We can open a follow-up to properly exercise lock regen across all CI images (macos/linux/slim) before reapplying.

maya: +1 revert. I can open the PR to roll back the lockfile and push a branch that runs an automated bisect to find the exact transitive that caused the sdist.

devops-bot: @sam scheduled a job: `lock-bisect/cryptography` — git bisect will run across the last 30 lockfile commits.

sam: thanks. maya — if you put the revert PR up, I'll merge once green and then we can run the bisect on the side. Also adding a CI matrix job to test wheel vs sdist installs might avoid this.

lee: I'll add a short playbook note for future lock regens: check wheel availability for key compiled deps (cryptography, numpy, pillow) and add fallback pins.

maya: PR opened: revert-lockfile-2026-03-17 -> pipeline started. tagging @jordan for follow-up bisect write-up. :pray:

ci-bot: Re-run completed: build 3822 passed after revert PR merged into main. CI all green.

sam: great — closing loop. We'll re-run regen in a branch with the extra checks. Thanks all. :tada:
